query: Automotive PCB assemblies South Korea import duties

statements.text: U.S. imports of intermediate and capital goods from Korea remain subject to relatively high tariff rates, ranging from 12.5 to 50 percent, under Section 301 and Section 232 measures.
U.S. imports of Korean products subject to Section 232 tariffs on the automotive sector are valued at USD 44.7 billion, accounting for approximately 36 percent of total U.S. imports from Korea.

For an automobile part that is the product of South Korea with a Column 1 duty rate less than 15 percent ad valorem, the combined Column 1 and additional Section 232 duty rate is 15 percent ad valorem. Use heading 9903.94.63.
Section 232 tariffs of 25% apply to certain auto parts, particularly those from countries without trade agreements.
The United States reduced its Section 232 sectoral tariffs on automobiles, auto parts, timber, lumber, and wood derivatives to 15 percent on an MFN-inclusive basis.
Auto Parts imported from South Korea are subject to the standard MFN base duty rate, plus Section 232 steel screening, Section 232 aluminum screening tariff overlays.
Auto Parts imported into the United States from South Korea must be classified under the correct HTS code before the US duty rate can be confirmed.

For an automobile part that is the product of South Korea with a Column 1 duty rate greater than or equal to 15 percent ad valorem, the additional Section 232 duty rate is zero (0). Use heading 9903.94.64.

Effective for automobiles and automobile parts entered for consumption or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern time on November 1, 2025, the Section 232 tariff is based on the ad valorem Column 1 (either Column 1-General or Column 1-Special) tariff applicable to the products.
Auto parts duty rates vary widely from 0% to 6% depending on the component.
